addedLines: - claude: Catch-all for any task that doesn't fit a more specific agent. FleetView's default when no agent name is typed. (Tools: *)

- claude-code-guide: Use this agent when the user asks questions ("Can Claude...", "Does Claude...", "How do I...") about: (1) Claude Code (the CLI tool) - features, hooks, slash commands, MCP servers, settings, IDE integrations, keyboard shortcuts; (2) Claude Agent SDK - building custom agents; (3) Claude API (formerly Anthropic API) - Messages API for directly passing messages to Claude, Tool Runner (`client.beta.messages.tool_runner`) for running an agentic loop over your own tools, manual tool-use loops, Managed Agents for server-hosted agents with a managed sandbox, prompt caching, and general Anthropic SDK usage; (4) Claude Tag (Claude in Slack) - what it is, setting it up for a Slack workspace, `/install-slack-app`. **IMPORTANT:** Before spawning a new agent, check if there is already a running or recently completed claude-code-guide agent that you can continue via SendMessage. (Tools: Bash, Read, WebFetch, WebSearch)

- Explore: Fast read-only search agent for locating code. Use it to find files by pattern (eg. "src/components/**/*.tsx"), grep for symbols or keywords (eg. "API endpoints"), or answer "where is X defined / which files reference Y." Do NOT use it for code review, design-doc auditing, cross-file consistency checks, or open-ended analysis — it reads excerpts rather than whole files and will miss content past its read window. When calling, specify search breadth: "quick" for a single targeted lookup, "medium" for moderate exploration, or "very thorough" to search across multiple locations and naming conventions. (Tools: All tools except Agent, Artifact, ExitPlanMode, Edit, Write, NotebookEdit)

- general-purpose: General-purpose agent for researching complex questions, searching for code, and executing multi-step tasks. When you are searching for a keyword or file and are not confident that you will find the right match in the first few tries use this agent to perform the search for you. (Tools: *)

- Plan: Software architect agent for designing implementation plans. Use this when you need to plan the implementation strategy for a task. Returns step-by-step plans, identifies critical files, and considers architectural trade-offs. (Tools: All tools except Agent, Artifact, ExitPlanMode, Edit, Write, NotebookEdit)
- statusline-setup: Use this agent to configure the user's Claude Code status line setting. (Tools: Read, Edit)

- trello-skill: Use when the user asks to create, manage, or query Trello boards, lists, cards, labels, members, checklists, or comments
- dataviz: Use this skill whenever you are about to create ANY chart, graph, plot, dashboard, or data visualization, in ANY output medium — an HTML or React artifact, inline SVG, plotting code in any library (matplotlib, plotly, d3, Recharts, …), an image/PNG you will render and upload, or a chart shared into Slack. Read it BEFORE writing the first line of chart code, choosing chart colors, building a stat tile / meter / KPI row, or laying out a dashboard. Produces visualizations that read as one system — elegant, accessible, consistent in light and dark — using a brand-neutral placeholder palette you swap for your own. Teaches a design-system-agnostic method: a form heuristic, a color formula with a runnable validator, mark specs, and interaction rules. A validated default palette is documented in `references/palette.md` — swap that file's values for your brand's. Triggers on: "chart", "graph", "plot", "data viz", "visualization", "dashboard", "analytics", "visualize data", "categorical colors", "sequential / diverging palette", "stat tile", "sparkline", "heatmap", "legend", "axis", "tooltip", "chart colors", "color by series".
- artifact-design: Design guidance and fundamentals for Artifacts.
- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.
- keybindings-help: Use when the user wants to customize keyboard shortcuts, rebind keys, add chord bindings, or modify ~/.claude/keybindings.json. Examples: "rebind ctrl+s", "add a chord shortcut", "change the submit key", "customize keybindings".
- verify: Verify that a code change actually does what it's supposed to by exercising it end-to-end and observing behavior — drive the affected flow, not just tests or typecheck. Run before committing nontrivial changes; bootstraps this repo's project verify skill if none exists yet. Don't invoke it on a diff that only touches tests, docs, or other code with no runtime surface to drive (a change to product source always has one) — there's nothing to observe.
- code-review: Review the current diff for correctness bugs and reuse/simplification/efficiency cleanups at the given effort level (low/medium: fewer, high-confidence findings; high→max: broader coverage, may include uncertain findings; ultra: deep multi-agent review in the cloud). Pass --comment to post findings as inline PR comments, or --fix to apply the findings to the working tree after the review.
- simplify: Review the changed code for reuse, simplification, efficiency, and altitude cleanups, then apply the fixes. Quality only — it does not hunt for bugs; use /code-review for that.
- fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.
- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo). Omit the interval to let the model self-pace. - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. "check the deploy every 5 minutes", "keep running /babysit-prs"). Do NOT invoke for one-off tasks.
- schedule: Create, update, list, or run scheduled cloud agents (routines) that execute on a cron schedule. - When the user wants to schedule a recurring cloud agent, set up automated tasks, create a cron job for Claude Code, or manage their scheduled agents/routines. Also use when the user wants a one-time scheduled run ("run this once at 3pm", "remind me to check X tomorrow").
- claude-api: Reference for the Claude API / Anthropic SDK — model ids, pricing, params, streaming, tool use, MCP, agents, caching, token counting, model migration.
TRIGGER — read BEFORE opening the target file; don't skip because it "looks like a one-liner" — whenever: the prompt names Claude/Anthropic in any form (Claude, Anthropic, Fable, Opus, Sonnet, Haiku, `anthropic`, `@anthropic-ai`, `claude-*`, `us.anthropic.*`, `[1m]`); the user asks about an LLM (pricing/model choice/limits/caching) — never answer from memory; OR the task is LLM-shaped with provider unstated (agent/MCP/tool-definition/multi-agent/RAG/LLM-judge/computer-use; generate/summarize/extract/classify/rewrite/converse over NL; debugging refusals/cutoffs/streaming/tool-calls/tokens).
SKIP only when another provider is being worked on (overrides all triggers): OpenAI/GPT/Gemini/Llama/Mistral/Cohere/Ollama named in the query; OR `grep -rE 'openai|langchain_openai|google.generativeai|genai|mistralai|cohere|ollama'` over the project hits (run this grep FIRST if no provider named — don't Read the file).
- run: Launch and drive this project's app to see a change working. Use when asked to run, start, or screenshot the app, or to confirm a change works in the real app (not just tests). First looks for a project skill that already covers launching the app; otherwise falls back to built-in patterns per project type (CLI, server, TUI, Electron, browser-driven, library).

- security-review: Complete a security review of the pending changes on the current branch

- [x] **14b. Preview per le cartelle (AssetManager).** La card della

  cartella **e dei suoi discendenti**, in ordine `order_column`. Riusa la
  catena di fallback della card asset (poster del job → originale se
  immagine); i media senza nulla di mostrabile (audio, preview fallita,
  job non ancora concluso) vengono saltati e la tile ricade sull'icona.

  preview compaiono da sole a job concluso.

  condividi/scarica/elimina nel **footer** dello slideover
  (`.fi-modal-footer-actions`), a sinistra, con "Chiudi" isolato a destra —
  via `extraModalFooterActions()` + `modalFooterActionsAlignment(Alignment::Start)`
  su `infoAssetAction` ([AssetManager.php](../packages/digital-hub/src/Assets/Filament/Pages/AssetManager.php)).

  `deleteAssetAction`), con `->arguments(['media' => $media->getKey()])`
  pre-riempito. `deleteAssetAction` ha in più `->cancelParentActions()` (API

  conferma — no-op quando invocata standalone dal menu contestuale (nessun
  parent da chiudere).

<?php

namespace AtrioTeam\DigitalHub\Assets\Support;

use AtrioTeam\DigitalHub\Assets\Metadata\ExtractedMetadata;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Support\Number;
use Spatie\MediaLibrary\MediaCollections\Models\Media;

/**
 * Metadati curati/normalizzati "di base" di un asset (digital-hub 22g).
 *

     *
     * La risoluzione compare per immagini e video. Con `$includeInternal` (default
     * true, pannello interno) si aggiungono date e autore dell'upload; la gallery
     * pubblica passa `false` per non esporre identità/tempi interni.
     *
     * @return list<array{label: string, value: string}>
     */
    public static function forMedia(Media $media, bool $includeInternal = true): array
    {
        $entries = [
            ['label' => __('digital-hub::assets.info_name'), 'value' => (string) $media->file_name],
            ['label' => __('digital-hub::assets.info_type'), 'value' => (string) $media->mime_type],
            ['label' => __('digital-hub::assets.info_size'), 'value' => (string) Number::fileSize((int) $media->size)],
        ];

        $dimensions = self::dimensions($media);
        if ($dimensions !== null) {
            $entries[] = ['label' => __('digital-hub::assets.info_dimensions'), 'value' => $dimensions];
        }

        if (! $includeInternal) {
            return $entries;
        }

        // i timestamp sono in UTC: mostrati in orario locale (Europe/Rome)
        $entries[] = ['label' => __('digital-hub::assets.info_created'), 'value' => (string) $media->created_at?->copy()->setTimezone('Europe/Rome')->format('d/m/Y H:i')];
        $entries[] = ['label' => __('digital-hub::assets.info_updated'), 'value' => (string) $media->updated_at?->copy()->setTimezone('Europe/Rome')->format('d/m/Y H:i')];

        $height = $common['height'] ?? null;

    public static function uploaderName(Media $media): ?string

        return is_string($snapshot) && $snapshot !== '' ? $snapshot : null;
    }

     * core non dipende dal model User dell'app). null se non configurato/trovato.

    {
        $model = config('auth.providers.users.model');
        if (! is_string($model) || ! class_exists($model)) {
            return null;
        }

        /** @var class-string<Model> $model */
        $user = $model::query()->find($id);

        return $user instanceof Model ? $user : null;
    }

1018	                    $this->downloadAssetAction()->button()->color('gray')->arguments(['media' => $media->getKey()]),

content.content:
# Example: Browser-driven web app

You have a dev server that serves HTML to a browser. An agent in a
headless container can't open a browser window — so "run the app" means
launching the dev server, driving a headless Chromium against it, and
producing a screenshot that proves the page rendered.

Don't write a browser driver. Use `chromium-cli`.

## Dev server

Find the dev command (`package.json` `scripts.dev`, `Makefile`,
README), start it in the background, and wait for it to actually serve:

```bash
npm run dev &   # or yarn dev, pnpm dev, make serve, ./dev.sh
echo $! > /tmp/dev.pid
timeout 30 bash -c 'until curl -sf http://localhost:3000 >/dev/null; do sleep 1; done'
```

Don't `sleep 5` — poll the port. Stop with
`kill $(cat /tmp/dev.pid)` (or `pkill -f 'npm run dev'`) before
relaunching, or the next run hits `EADDRINUSE`.

## Drive

`chromium-cli` is a headless-Chromium REPL. Pipe a script to stdin:

```bash
chromium-cli --session app <<'EOF'
nav http://localhost:3000
wait-for text=Dashboard
screenshot
click button:has-text("New item")
fill input[name="title"] Smoke test
press Enter
wait-for text=Smoke test
screenshot
console --errors
EOF
```

Screenshots land in `chromium_cli/sessions/app/screenshots/` (latest
symlinked as `screenshot.png`). That's the whole loop: `nav` →
`wait-for` the element you need → act (`click` / `fill` / `type` /
`press`) → `screenshot` → `console --errors` to check nothing threw.
Full command reference: `chromium-cli` skill, or `help` at the prompt.

For iterative debugging, run it under tmux and `send-keys` one command
at a time — same commands, same session.

**If `chromium-cli` isn't available:** adapt
[electron.md](electron.md)'s REPL driver — the structure and commands
transfer, but it's `_electron`-specific:
import `{ chromium }` instead, launch with
`chromium.launch({ args: ['--no-sandbox'] })`, acquire the page via
`(await app.newContext()).newPage()` then `goto()` your dev URL, and
drop the Electron-only window introspection
(`.windows()`/`.firstWindow()`/the `windows` command).

## What to put in the skill

The project-specific bits only. `chromium-cli` handles the mechanics.

- **Dev command + port + stop.** The exact start line, any env vars it
  needs, and the `kill`/`pkill` to stop it.
- **Auth.** Whatever gets a logged-in session — a `set-cookie` line, a
  `fill`/`click` login sequence, or a helper script that does the API
  dance and emits the cookie.
- **One representative interaction.** Not the whole app — one path that
  proves it's running, ending in a screenshot.
- **App-specific gotchas.** Only the ones you actually hit.

## Gotchas that recur

- **React controlled inputs.** `eval el.value = '…'` doesn't fire
  React's onChange. Use `fill` / `type` — they go through Playwright's
  input pipeline.
- **Websockets / long-poll.** `wait-idle` never settles. `wait-for` the
  element you actually need.
- **Slow first paint.** Vite/Next compile routes on demand; the first
  `nav` can take 10s+. `wait-for` handles it; raw `sleep` doesn't.
- **`screenshot-element <sel>`** crops to one element — use it when the
  diff is in a specific component, not the whole page.
- **Check `console --errors` before declaring success.** A page can
  render its shell while every data fetch 500s.

<?php

namespace Filament\Actions\Concerns;

use Filament\Actions\Contracts\HasActions;
use Livewire\Component;

trait BelongsToLivewire
{
    protected Component $livewire;

    public function livewire(Component $livewire): static
    {
        $this->livewire = $livewire;

        return $this;
    }

    public function getLivewire(): ?object
    {
        if (isset($this->livewire)) {
            return $this->livewire;
        }

        if ($livewire = $this->getSchemaContainer()?->getLivewire()) {
            return $livewire;
        }

        if ($livewire = $this->getSchemaComponent()?->getLivewire()) {
            return $livewire;
        }

        if ($livewire = $this->getTable()?->getLivewire()) {
            return $livewire;
        }

        return $this->getGroup()?->getLivewire();
    }

    public function getHasActionsLivewire(): ?HasActions
    {
        $livewire = $this->getLivewire();

        if (! $livewire instanceof HasActions) {
            return null;
        }

        return $livewire;
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Tests\Feature\Assets;

use App\Models\Product;
use App\Models\User;
use AtrioTeam\DigitalHub\Assets\Filament\Pages\AssetManager;
use AtrioTeam\DigitalHub\Assets\Jobs\ProcessAssetJob;
use AtrioTeam\DigitalHub\Assets\Metadata\ExtractedMetadata;
use AtrioTeam\DigitalHub\Assets\Support\AssetFileReplacer;
use AtrioTeam\DigitalHub\Assets\Support\AssetPreview;
use AtrioTeam\DigitalHub\Assets\Support\AssetProcessingStatus;
use Filament\Facades\Filament;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Http\UploadedFile;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Queue;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
use Livewire\Livewire;
use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * Sostituzione del file fisico di un asset (digital-hub 22i): il record Media
 * mantiene lo stesso id (dati e relazioni preservati), cambia solo il file e
 * i suoi attributi; metadati/anteprima azzerati e job rielaborazione in coda.
 */
class AssetFileReplaceTest extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;

    public function test_replace_keeps_id_updates_file_and_requeues_processing(): void
    {
        Storage::fake('assets');
        Queue::fake();

        $product = Product::create(['name' => ['it' => 'Tavolo']]);
        $media = $product
            ->addMediaFromString('vecchio contenuto')
            ->usingFileName('old.txt')
            ->toMediaCollection('assets');

        // simula un asset già elaborato: metadati estratti + poster generato
        ExtractedMetadata::write($media, ['common' => ['size' => 17]]);
        $disk = Storage::disk('assets');
        $disk->put(AssetPreview::relativePath($media), 'poster');
        $media->setCustomProperty(AssetPreview::PROPERTY, AssetPreview::relativePath($media));
        $media->setAttribute('processing_status', AssetProcessingStatus::Completed->value);
        $media->save();

        $originalId = $media->getKey();
        $oldPath = $media->getPathRelativeToRoot();

        AssetFileReplacer::replace($media, UploadedFile::fake()->createWithContent('nuovo file.pdf', '%PDF-1.4 nuovo'));

        // stesso record, attributi del nuovo file (nome sanitizzato come spatie)
        $media->refresh();
        $this->assertSame($originalId, $media->getKey());
        $this->assertSame('nuovo-file.pdf', $media->file_name);
        $this->assertSame(strlen('%PDF-1.4 nuovo'), $media->size);

        // file fisico: il nuovo esiste, il vecchio e il poster sono stati rimossi
        $disk->assertExists($media->getPathRelativeToRoot());
        $disk->assertMissing($oldPath);
        $disk->assertMissing(AssetPreview::relativePath($media));
        $this->assertSame('%PDF-1.4 nuovo', $disk->get($media->getPathRelativeToRoot()));

        // stato azzerato + job in coda
        $this->assertSame([], ExtractedMetadata::forMedia($media));
        $this->assertNull($media->getCustomProperty(AssetPreview::PROPERTY));
        $this->assertSame(AssetProcessingStatus::Pending->value, $media->getAttribute('processing_status'));
        Queue::assertPushed(ProcessAssetJob::class, fn (ProcessAssetJob $job): bool => $job->mediaId === $originalId);
    }

    public function test_replace_with_same_file_name_overwrites_in_place(): void
    {
        Storage::fake('assets');
        Queue::fake();

        $product = Product::create(['name' => ['it' => 'Tavolo']]);
        $media = $product
            ->addMediaFromString('vecchio')
            ->usingFileName('doc.txt')
            ->toMediaCollection('assets');

        AssetFileReplacer::replace($media, UploadedFile::fake()->createWithContent('doc.txt', 'nuovo'));

        $media->refresh();
        $this->assertSame('doc.txt', $media->file_name);
        $this->assertSame('nuovo', Storage::disk('assets')->get($media->getPathRelativeToRoot()));
    }

    public function test_replace_action_is_wired_in_asset_manager(): void
    {
        Storage::fake('assets');
        Queue::fake();

        $this->actingAs(User::factory()->create());
        Filament::setCurrentPanel('admin');

        $product = Product::create(['name' => ['it' => 'Tavolo']]);
        $media = $product
            ->addMediaFromString('vecchio')
            ->usingFileName('doc.txt')
            ->toMediaCollection('assets');

        // smoke di wiring: l'action monta con il media come argument e il form
        // di upload si renderizza senza errori (l'esecuzione è coperta sopra)
        Livewire::test(AssetManager::class, ['ownerType' => 'product', 'owner' => $product->getKey()])
            ->mountAction('replaceAssetFile', ['media' => $media->getKey()])
            ->assertActionMounted('replaceAssetFile')
            ->assertOk();
    }
}

     embedded. L'audio resta col solo player inline; gli altri tipi (archivi,
     documenti, cad, generici) non hanno zoom — vedi AssetFileType::isZoomable().

     dello schema, altrimenti Livewire non riesce ad avviarla (non basta un

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace AtrioTeam\DigitalHub\Assets\Http\Controllers;

use AtrioTeam\DigitalHub\Assets\Models\AssetShare;
use AtrioTeam\DigitalHub\Assets\Support\AssetPreview;
use AtrioTeam\DigitalHub\Assets\Support\AssetZip;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Gate;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
use Spatie\MediaLibrary\MediaCollections\Models\Media;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\Response;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\StreamedResponse;

/**
 * Serving gated degli asset (digital-hub 22d, design §7.10).
 *
 * Gli asset vivono su disco PRIVATO (non esposto via symlink/URL pubblico):
 * ogni accesso al file passa di qui, che decide chi può vederlo. Due rami di
 * autorizzazione (design §7.10):
 *
 *  1. Richiesta firmata (signed URL temporaneo) → accesso concesso dalla firma
 *     stessa. È il meccanismo per l'embedding senza sessione e per la
 *     condivisione esterna (22g, gallery `/share/{token}` con token proprio).
 *  2. Utente autenticato nel pannello → si applica la policy sul proprietario
 *     dell'asset quando esiste (authz interna §7.1: A+B nativi, C on demand).
 *     Senza policy registrata sul proprietario, basta l'autenticazione.
 *
 * Il file è servito inline. Per i dischi locali si usa una BinaryFileResponse
 * (supporta le Range request → seeking di video/audio); per dischi remoti si
 * ricade sullo stream del filesystem.
 */
class AssetServeController
{
    /** Serve il file originale dell'asset. */
    public function show(Request $request, Media $media): Response
    {
        $this->authorizeAccess($request, $media);

        return $this->serve($media, $media->getPathRelativeToRoot(), $media->mime_type);
    }

    /**
     * Download multiplo come zip in streaming (22e). L'accesso è dato dal token
     * dello {@see AssetShare}: il token è il segreto, qui si verifica solo che lo
     * share esista e non sia scaduto. Streaming vero verso il browser, senza
     * buffering Livewire. Stessa rotta usata dalla condivisione esterna (22g).
     */
    public function downloadShareZip(string $token): StreamedResponse
    {
        $share = AssetShare::query()->where('token', $token)->first();
        abort_if($share === null || $share->isExpired(), 404);

        // share protetto da password (22g): scaricabile solo dopo lo sblocco nella
        // gallery (gate condiviso via sessione, design §7.10). Gli share effimeri del
        // download multiplo (22e) non hanno password → nessun gate.
        abort_if($share->hasPassword() && session()->get($share->sessionUnlockKey()) !== true, 403);

        $media = $share->media()->get();
        abort_if($media->isEmpty(), 404);

        $name = 'assets-' . now()->format('Ymd-His') . '.zip';

        return AssetZip::streamResponse($media, $name);
    }

    /** Serve il poster/anteprima generato per l'asset (404 se assente). */
    public function preview(Request $request, Media $media): Response
    {
        $this->authorizeAccess($request, $media);

        $path = $media->getCustomProperty(AssetPreview::PROPERTY);
        abort_unless(is_string($path) && $path !== '', 404);

        return $this->serve($media, $path, 'image/jpeg');
    }

    /**
     * Autorizza l'accesso al media. Vedi i due rami descritti sul controller.
     */
    private function authorizeAccess(Request $request, Media $media): void
    {
        if ($request->hasValidSignature()) {
            return;
        }

        $user = $request->user();
        abort_if($user === null, 403);

        // Proprietario morph dell'asset (es. Product). Si applica la sua policy
        // solo se ne esiste una registrata: il core non impone authz per-record,
        // la abilita quando il template la fornisce (shield / policy custom).
        $owner = $media->model;
        if ($owner !== null && Gate::getPolicyFor($owner) !== null) {
            abort_if(Gate::forUser($user)->denies('view', $owner), 403);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Risposta inline per un path relativo al disco del media. Usa una
     * BinaryFileResponse (Range/seeking) sui dischi locali, lo stream del
     * filesystem altrimenti.
     */
    private function serve(Media $media, string $relativePath, ?string $mime): Response
    {
        $disk = Storage::disk($media->disk);
        abort_unless($disk->exists($relativePath), 404);

        $headers = $mime !== null ? ['Content-Type' => $mime] : [];

        // Disco locale: path assoluto risolvibile a un file reale → BinaryFileResponse,
        // che gestisce nativamente le Range request (seeking video/audio). Su dischi
        // remoti (es. s3) il path non è un file locale → stream del filesystem.
        $absolute = $disk->path($relativePath);
        if (is_file($absolute)) {
            return response()->file($absolute, $headers);
        }

        return $disk->response($relativePath, $media->file_name, $headers, 'inline');
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace AtrioTeam\DigitalHub\Assets\Support;

/**
 * Stato di elaborazione di un asset (digital-hub #16/#18).
 *
 * Al caricamento un media entra `pending`; un job in coda
 * ({@see \AtrioTeam\DigitalHub\Assets\Jobs\ProcessAssetJob}) estrae metadati e
 * dimensioni (oggi) e potrà generare taglie/altre elaborazioni (domani),
 * portandolo a `completed` o, in caso di errore, a `failed`.
 *
 * pending vs processing è una distinzione interna (in coda vs in lavorazione):
 * all'utente sono presentati uguali ("In elaborazione"), vedi {@see self::label()}.
 *
 * Valore null sulla colonna `media.processing_status` = asset non gestito dalla
 * pipeline (media legacy o di altre collection): in UI è trattato come neutro.
 */
enum AssetProcessingStatus: string
{
    case Pending = 'pending';
    case Processing = 'processing';
    case Completed = 'completed';
    case Failed = 'failed';

    /**
     * In lavorazione: in coda o in elaborazione. La UI mostra l'overlay di attesa.
     */
    public function isInProgress(): bool
    {
        return $this === self::Pending || $this === self::Processing;
    }

    public function isFailed(): bool
    {
        return $this === self::Failed;
    }

    /**
     * Etichetta localizzata per la UI (chiave `assets.status_<valore>`).
     */
    public function label(): string
    {
        return (string) __('digital-hub::assets.status_' . $this->value);
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace AtrioTeam\DigitalHub\Assets\Support;

use DateTimeInterface;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\URL;
use Spatie\MediaLibrary\MediaCollections\Models\Media;

/**
 * Fonte unica degli URL di accesso agli asset (digital-hub 22d, design §7.10).
 *
 * Gli asset stanno su disco privato e si servono attraverso la route gata
 * {@see \AtrioTeam\DigitalHub\Assets\Http\Controllers\AssetServeController}:
 * NON si usa più `Media::getUrl()` / `Storage::url()` (che richiederebbero un
 * disco pubblico). Le UI del pannello usano gli URL "normali" (gata via
 * sessione); le varianti `temporary*` producono signed URL temporanei per
 * l'embedding senza sessione e per il riuso esterno (condivisione 22g).
 */
class AssetUrl
{
    /** URL dell'originale, gato via sessione+policy. */
    public static function original(Media $media): string
    {
        return route('digital-hub.assets.show', ['media' => $media->getKey()]);
    }

    /** URL del poster/anteprima, o null se l'asset non ne ha uno generato. */
    public static function preview(Media $media): ?string
    {
        if (! self::hasPreview($media)) {
            return null;
        }

        return route('digital-hub.assets.preview', ['media' => $media->getKey()]);
    }

    /** Signed URL temporaneo all'originale (embedding senza sessione / esterno). */
    public static function temporaryOriginal(Media $media, DateTimeInterface $expiresAt): string
    {
        return URL::temporarySignedRoute('digital-hub.assets.show', $expiresAt, ['media' => $media->getKey()]);
    }

    /** Signed URL temporaneo al poster, o null se assente. */
    public static function temporaryPreview(Media $media, DateTimeInterface $expiresAt): ?string
    {
        if (! self::hasPreview($media)) {
            return null;
        }

        return URL::temporarySignedRoute('digital-hub.assets.preview', $expiresAt, ['media' => $media->getKey()]);
    }

    private static function hasPreview(Media $media): bool
    {
        $path = $media->getCustomProperty(AssetPreview::PROPERTY);

        return is_string($path) && $path !== '';
    }
}

 * disco pubblico). Le UI del pannello usano gli URL "normali" (gata via
 * sessione); le varianti `temporary*` producono signed URL temporanei per
 * l'embedding senza sessione e per il riuso esterno (condivisione 22g).
 */
class AssetUrl
{
    /** URL dell'originale, gato via sessione+policy. */
    public static function original(Media $media): string
    {
        return route('digital-hub.assets.show', ['media' => $media->getKey()]);
    }

    /** URL del poster/anteprima, o null se l'asset non ne ha uno generato. */
    public static function preview(Media $media): ?string
    {
        if (! self::hasPreview($media)) {
            return null;
        }

        return route('digital-hub.assets.preview', ['media' => $media->getKey()]);
    }

    /** Signed URL temporaneo all'originale (embedding senza sessione / esterno). */
    public static function temporaryOriginal(Media $media, DateTimeInterface $expiresAt): string
    {
        return URL::temporarySignedRoute('digital-hub.assets.show', $expiresAt, ['media' => $media->getKey()]);
    }

    /** Signed URL temporaneo al poster, o null se assente. */
    public static function temporaryPreview(Media $media, DateTimeInterface $expiresAt): ?string
    {
        if (! self::hasPreview($media)) {
            return null;
        }

        return URL::temporarySignedRoute('digital-hub.assets.preview', $expiresAt, ['media' => $media->getKey()]);
    }

    private static function hasPreview(Media $media): bool
    {
        $path = $media->getCustomProperty(AssetPreview::PROPERTY);

        return is_string($path) && $path !== '';
    }
}

1. **Anteprima non aggiornata dopo la sostituzione file** — [AssetUrl.php](../packages/digital-hub/src/Assets/Support/AssetUrl.php): aggiunto un cache-buster (`?v=<updated_at>`) a tutti gli URL di asset/poster. Senza, la URL restava identica a parità di id media, quindi né la cache HTTP del browser né il diffing DOM di Livewire rilevavano il cambiamento (stesso `src`). Corregge sia il tile in griglia sia la preview nello slideover, senza bisogno di ricaricare la pagina.

2. **Stato "in elaborazione" nella preview dello slideover** — [asset-preview.blade.php](../packages/digital-hub/resources/views/filament/partials/asset-preview.blade.php): aggiunto lo stesso overlay (spinner + etichetta) già presente nella griglia, finché `processing_status` non è `completed`.

3. **Auto-refresh dello slideover mentre il job gira** — [AssetManager.php](../packages/digital-hub/src/Assets/Filament/Pages/AssetManager.php): `wire:poll.3s` condizionale sul pannello, stesso pattern già usato per la griglia, così l'overlay sparisce da solo appena il job finisce, senza chiudere/riaprire lo slideover.

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace AtrioTeam\DigitalHub\Assets\Filament\Actions;

use AtrioTeam\DigitalHub\Assets\Filament\Pages\AssetManager;
use Filament\Actions\Action;
use Filament\Support\Icons\Heroicon;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;

/**
 * Azione di riga che apre la {@see AssetManager} per il record (digital-hub #16).
 *
 * Generica: usabile nella tabella di qualunque resource il cui modello usa il
 * trait HasAssets. L'URL è costruito dalla coppia polimorfica del record
 * (morph alias + chiave); perché l'alias sia leggibile nell'URL il template
 * deve registrare il record in una morph map (es. `Relation::morphMap`).
 */
class ManageAssetsAction
{
    public static function make(string $name = 'manageAssets'): Action
    {
        return Action::make($name)
            ->label(__('digital-hub::assets.manage'))
            ->icon(Heroicon::OutlinedFolderOpen)
            ->url(fn (Model $record): string => AssetManager::getUrl([
                'ownerType' => $record->getMorphClass(),
                'owner' => $record->getKey(),
            ]));
    }
}

content.text:
Trovata la causa — non era un bug del meccanismo di overlay, ma di navigazione: l'asset in questione (`8.jpg`, id=1) sta dentro una sottocartella (folder id=1), mentre l'AssetManager all'apertura mostra sempre la **root**. Sulla root non vedi il file direttamente (solo la tile della cartella), quindi l'overlay "in elaborazione" non compare — semplicemente perché quel file non è nella vista corrente. Quando navighi dentro la cartella (o clicchi sulla tile della cartella), il file compare con l'overlay corretto.

Ho verificato con un test mirato sui dati reali: sulla root (`activeFolderId = null`) zero occorrenze del file o dello stato; selezionando la cartella 1 (`selectFolder(1)`), sia il file che l'etichetta "in elaborazione" compaiono correttamente.

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Tests\Feature\Assets;

use App\Models\Product;
use App\Models\User;
use AtrioTeam\DigitalHub\Assets\Filament\Pages\AssetManager;
use AtrioTeam\DigitalHub\Assets\Models\AssetFolder;
use AtrioTeam\DigitalHub\Assets\Support\AssetProcessingStatus;
use Filament\Facades\Filament;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
use Livewire\Livewire;
use Spatie\MediaLibrary\MediaCollections\Models\Media;
use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * Preview delle tile cartella nell'AssetManager (14b): collage fino a 4
 * miniature dai media contenuti nella sottocartella o nei suoi discendenti,
 * saltando i media senza nulla di mostrabile; polling esteso ai sottoalberi
 * quando contengono asset in lavorazione.
 */
class AssetFolderPreviewTest extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;

    private Product $product;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        Storage::fake('assets');
        $this->actingAs(User::factory()->create());
        Filament::setCurrentPanel('admin');

        $this->product = Product::create(['name' => ['it' => 'Tavolo']]);
    }

    public function test_subfolder_preview_uses_image_from_descendant_folder(): void
    {
        $parent = $this->product->createAssetFolder('Documenti');
        $child = $this->product->createAssetFolder('2024', $parent);
        $grandchild = $this->product->createAssetFolder('Gennaio', $child);

        // l'immagine sta due livelli sotto la tile: deve contare comunque
        $this->addImage($grandchild);

        $previews = $this->pageWithActiveFolder($parent)->getSubfolderPreviews();

        $this->assertCount(1, $previews[$child->id]);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('/assets/', $previews[$child->id][0]);
    }

    public function test_media_without_displayable_preview_is_skipped(): void
    {
        $parent = $this->product->createAssetFolder('Documenti');
        $child = $this->product->createAssetFolder('Audio', $parent);

        // niente poster generato e non è un'immagine → nessuna miniatura, tile a icona
        $this->product
            ->addMediaFromString('not an image')
            ->usingFileName('track.mp3')
            ->toMediaCollection('assets')
            ->update(['asset_folder_id' => $child->id]);

        $previews = $this->pageWithActiveFolder($parent)->getSubfolderPreviews();

        $this->assertSame([], $previews[$child->id]);
    }

    public function test_preview_collage_is_capped_at_four_thumbnails(): void
    {
        $parent = $this->product->createAssetFolder('Documenti');
        $child = $this->product->createAssetFolder('Foto', $parent);

        foreach (range(1, 5) as $i) {
            $this->addImage($child, "photo-{$i}.jpg");
        }

        $previews = $this->pageWithActiveFolder($parent)->getSubfolderPreviews();

        $this->assertCount(AssetManager::FOLDER_PREVIEW_LIMIT, $previews[$child->id]);
    }

    public function test_file_count_includes_descendants_and_non_displayable_media(): void
    {
        $parent = $this->product->createAssetFolder('Documenti');
        $child = $this->product->createAssetFolder('2024', $parent);
        $grandchild = $this->product->createAssetFolder('Gennaio', $child);
        $empty = $this->product->createAssetFolder('Vuota', $parent);

        $this->addImage($child, 'a.jpg');
        $this->addImage($grandchild, 'b.jpg');

        // conta anche i media senza anteprima mostrabile
        $this->product
            ->addMediaFromString('not an image')
            ->usingFileName('track.mp3')
            ->toMediaCollection('assets')
            ->update(['asset_folder_id' => $grandchild->id]);

        $counts = $this->pageWithActiveFolder($parent)->getSubfolderFileCounts();

        $this->assertSame(3, $counts[$child->id]);
        $this->assertSame(0, $counts[$empty->id]);
    }

    public function test_processing_media_in_subfolder_tree_extends_polling(): void
    {
        $parent = $this->product->createAssetFolder('Documenti');
        $child = $this->product->createAssetFolder('Foto', $parent);

        $media = $this->addImage($child);
        $media->update(['processing_status' => AssetProcessingStatus::Processing->value]);

        $this->assertTrue($this->pageWithActiveFolder($parent)->hasProcessingInSubfolders());

        $media->update(['processing_status' => AssetProcessingStatus::Completed->value]);

        $this->assertFalse($this->pageWithActiveFolder($parent)->hasProcessingInSubfolders());
    }

    /**
     * Istanza della page con la folder attiva impostata, per chiamare i metodi
     * di preview come farebbe il blade.
     */
    private function pageWithActiveFolder(AssetFolder $folder): AssetManager
    {
        /** @var AssetManager $page */
        $page = Livewire::test(AssetManager::class, ['ownerType' => 'product', 'owner' => $this->product->getKey()])
            ->call('selectFolder', $folder->id)
            ->instance();

        return $page;
    }

    private function addImage(AssetFolder $folder, string $fileName = 'photo.jpg'): Media
    {
        $image = imagecreatetruecolor(40, 25);
        ob_start();
        imagejpeg($image);
        $bytes = (string) ob_get_clean();

        $media = $this->product
            ->addMediaFromString($bytes)
            ->usingFileName($fileName)
            ->toMediaCollection('assets');

        $media->update(['asset_folder_id' => $folder->id]);

        return $media;
    }
}

namespace Tests\Feature\Assets;

use AtrioTeam\DigitalHub\Assets\Models\AssetFolder;
use AtrioTeam\DigitalHub\Assets\Support\AssetProcessingStatus;
use Filament\Facades\Filament;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;

use Livewire\Livewire;
use Spatie\MediaLibrary\MediaCollections\Models\Media;
use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * Preview delle tile cartella nell'AssetManager (14b): collage fino a 4
 * miniature dai media contenuti nella sottocartella o nei suoi discendenti,
 * saltando i media senza nulla di mostrabile; polling esteso ai sottoalberi
 * quando contengono asset in lavorazione.
 */
class AssetFolderPreviewTest extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;

    private Product $product;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        Storage::fake('assets');
        $this->actingAs(User::factory()->create());
        Filament::setCurrentPanel('admin');

        $this->product = Product::create(['name' => ['it' => 'Tavolo']]);
    }

    public function test_subfolder_preview_uses_image_from_descendant_folder(): void
    {
        $parent = $this->product->createAssetFolder('Documenti');
        $child = $this->product->createAssetFolder('2024', $parent);
        $grandchild = $this->product->createAssetFolder('Gennaio', $child);

        // l'immagine sta due livelli sotto la tile: deve contare comunque
        $this->addImage($grandchild);

        $previews = $this->pageWithActiveFolder($parent)->getSubfolderPreviews();

        $this->assertCount(1, $previews[$child->id]);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('/assets/', $previews[$child->id][0]['url']);
        $this->assertFalse($previews[$child->id][0]['inProgress']);
    }

    public function test_media_without_displayable_preview_is_skipped(): void
    {
        $parent = $this->product->createAssetFolder('Documenti');
        $child = $this->product->createAssetFolder('Audio', $parent);

        // niente poster generato e non è un'immagine → nessuna miniatura, tile a icona
        $this->product
            ->addMediaFromString('not an image')
            ->usingFileName('track.mp3')
            ->toMediaCollection('assets')
            ->update(['asset_folder_id' => $child->id]);

        $previews = $this->pageWithActiveFolder($parent)->getSubfolderPreviews();

        $this->assertSame([], $previews[$child->id]);
    }

    public function test_preview_collage_is_capped_at_four_thumbnails(): void
    {
        $parent = $this->product->createAssetFolder('Documenti');
        $child = $this->product->createAssetFolder('Foto', $parent);

        foreach (range(1, 5) as $i) {
            $this->addImage($child, "photo-{$i}.jpg");
        }

        $previews = $this->pageWithActiveFolder($parent)->getSubfolderPreviews();

        $this->assertCount(AssetManager::FOLDER_PREVIEW_LIMIT, $previews[$child->id]);
    }

    public function test_file_count_includes_descendants_and_non_displayable_media(): void
    {
        $parent = $this->product->createAssetFolder('Documenti');
        $child = $this->product->createAssetFolder('2024', $parent);
        $grandchild = $this->product->createAssetFolder('Gennaio', $child);
        $empty = $this->product->createAssetFolder('Vuota', $parent);

        $this->addImage($child, 'a.jpg');
        $this->addImage($grandchild, 'b.jpg');

        // conta anche i media senza anteprima mostrabile
        $this->product
            ->addMediaFromString('not an image')
            ->usingFileName('track.mp3')
            ->toMediaCollection('assets')
            ->update(['asset_folder_id' => $grandchild->id]);

        $counts = $this->pageWithActiveFolder($parent)->getSubfolderFileCounts();

        $this->assertSame(3, $counts[$child->id]);
        $this->assertSame(0, $counts[$empty->id]);
    }

    public function test_processing_media_in_subfolder_tree_extends_polling(): void
    {
        $parent = $this->product->createAssetFolder('Documenti');
        $child = $this->product->createAssetFolder('Foto', $parent);

        $media = $this->addImage($child);
        $media->update(['processing_status' => AssetProcessingStatus::Processing->value]);

        $this->assertTrue($this->pageWithActiveFolder($parent)->hasProcessingInSubfolders());

        $media->update(['processing_status' => AssetProcessingStatus::Completed->value]);

    }

    /**
     * Istanza della page con la folder attiva impostata, per chiamare i metodi
     * di preview come farebbe il blade.
     */
    private function pageWithActiveFolder(AssetFolder $folder): AssetManager
    {
        /** @var AssetManager $page */
        $page = Livewire::test(AssetManager::class, ['ownerType' => 'product', 'owner' => $this->product->getKey()])
            ->call('selectFolder', $folder->id)
            ->instance();

        return $page;
    }

    private function addImage(AssetFolder $folder, string $fileName = 'photo.jpg'): Media
    {
        $image = imagecreatetruecolor(40, 25);
        ob_start();
        imagejpeg($image);
        $bytes = (string) ob_get_clean();

        $media = $this->product
            ->addMediaFromString($bytes)
            ->usingFileName($fileName)
            ->toMediaCollection('assets');

        $media->update(['asset_folder_id' => $folder->id]);

        return $media;
    }
}

**Trovata la causa reale**: non era un problema di navigazione — la preview del file compare correttamente nella tile della griglia **e** nel mosaico della cartella-tile in Home (le immagini si mostrano subito, anche da `pending`, perché l'originale è già leggero), ma solo la tile del file "singolo" aveva l'overlay "in elaborazione"; il mosaico/anteprima delle sottocartelle in Home no.

Corretto in [AssetManager.php](../packages/digital-hub/src/Assets/Filament/Pages/AssetManager.php) e [asset-manager.blade.php](../packages/digital-hub/resources/views/filament/pages/asset-manager.blade.php):
- `getSubfolderPreviews()` ora restituisce anche il flag `inProgress` per ogni miniatura (non solo l'URL)
- Il blade mostra lo spinner "in elaborazione" anche sulle miniature delle tile cartella (sia nel caso a preview singola sia nel mosaico), stessa icona/stile della card file

Verificato sui dati reali: `getSubfolderPreviews()` per il prodotto/cartella in questione ora ritorna `inProgress => true` per `8.jpg`. Aggiornati/aggiunti test in `AssetFolderPreviewTest.php` (59 test verdi, PHPStan pulito).

     */
    protected array | Closure | null $schema = null;

    protected bool | Closure $isSchemaDisabled = false;

     */
    public function schema(array | Closure | null $schema): static
    {
        $this->schema = $schema;

        return $this;
    }

    public function disabledSchema(bool | Closure $condition = true): static
    {
        $this->isSchemaDisabled = $condition;

        return $this;
    }

    public function isSchemaDisabled(): bool
    {
        return (bool) $this->evaluate($this->isSchemaDisabled);
    }

    public function getSchema(Schema $schema): ?Schema
    {
        $modifiedSchema = $this->evaluate($this->schema ?? $this->getHasActionsLivewire()?->getDefaultActionSchemaResolver($this), [
            'form' => $schema,
            'schema' => $schema,
            'infolist' => $schema,

                ->startOnStep($this->getWizardStartStep())
                ->cancelAction($this->getModalCancelAction())

                ->skippable($this->isWizardSkippable())

<?php

namespace Filament\Support\Concerns;

use Closure;
use Illuminate\View\ComponentAttributeBag;

trait HasExtraAttributes
{
    /**
     * @var array<array<mixed> | Closure>
     */
    protected array $extraAttributes = [];

    /**
     * @param  array<mixed> | Closure  $attributes
     */
    public function extraAttributes(array | Closure $attributes, bool $merge = false): static
    {
        // Security: Attribute values are not escaped when rendered. Never
        // pass unsanitized user input as attribute names or values.

        if ($merge) {
            $this->extraAttributes[] = $attributes;
        } else {
            $this->extraAttributes = [$attributes];
        }

        return $this;
    }

    /**
     * @return array<mixed>
     */
    public function getExtraAttributes(): array
    {
        $temporaryAttributeBag = new ComponentAttributeBag;

        foreach ($this->extraAttributes as $extraAttributes) {
            $temporaryAttributeBag = $temporaryAttributeBag->merge($this->evaluate($extraAttributes), escape: false);
        }

        return $temporaryAttributeBag->getAttributes();
    }

    public function getExtraAttributeBag(): ComponentAttributeBag
    {
        return new ComponentAttributeBag($this->getExtraAttributes());
    }
}

lines: * Tab del pannello info: "Informazioni" (metadati curati/normalizzati) e
* "Metadati completi" (`extracted_metadata` grezzo, un blocco per tipo). Il
* secondo tab compare solo se ci sono metadati estratti.
+     * Prende l'id del media, non l'oggetto: lo schema di 'infoAsset' viene
+     * costruito una sola volta al mount e resta in cache (Filament,
+     * `mountedActionSchema`) per tutta la vita dell'action montata — non si
+     * ricostruisce da solo dopo "sostituisci file" (mount nidificato che cambia
+     * il media sotto). I VALORI delle entry sono quindi closure che rifanno il
+     * fetch a ogni render (vedi assetInfoEntries/assetMetadataSections); la sola
+     * cosa che resta congelata all'apertura del pannello è la PRESENZA del tab
+     * "Metadati completi" (decisa qui, una volta) — se il replace cambia tipo di
+     * file passando da "senza metadati" a "con metadati" o viceversa, il tab
+     * segue lo stato di quando il pannello è stato aperto, non quello corrente.
// seconda tab con le sezioni degli altri gruppi di metadati
* il KeyValueEntry rende solo coppie chiave→scalare. Vuoto se non ci sono
+     * `$media` (già risolto dal chiamante, per decidere quali blocchi esistono)
+     * serve solo a stabilire QUALI sezioni costruire; il CONTENUTO di ciascuna
+     * (`KeyValueEntry::state()`) è una closure che rilegge `$mediaKey` a ogni
+     * render, così un reprocess successivo (nuovi metadati) si riflette senza
* Voci (sola lettura) del tab "Informazioni": metadati curati/normalizzati,
* dalla fonte unica {@see AssetSummary} (condivisa con la gallery di share).
+     * Ogni valore è una closure che rilegge il media da `$mediaKey` a ogni
+     * render (vedi assetInfoTabs): il NUMERO di entry resta quello di quando il
+     * pannello è stato aperto (es. se il replace introduce/rimuove la voce
+     * "Risoluzione" cambiando tipo di file, non compare/scompare da sola).

spiegami il senso del controllo su mediaKey alla riga 1043 di AssetManager

Buona domanda — vale la pena chiarirlo perché a prima vista sembra un controllo inutile (una chiave primaria è sempre int o string).

Il punto è **PHPStan**, non la logica a runtime. `Media::getKey()` (ereditato dalla classe base Eloquent) ha tipo di ritorno `mixed`, non `int|string`. Se scrivessi semplicemente:

```php
$mediaKey = $media?->getKey();
```

PHPStan vedrebbe `$mediaKey` come `mixed`, e più sotto lo passo a metodi tipizzati stretti — `assetInfoTabs(int|string $mediaKey)`, `findOwnedMedia()`, gli `arguments(['media' => $mediaKey])` — che si aspettano `int|string`. Senza restringere il tipo, l'analisi fallirebbe con `expects int|string, mixed given` (è esattamente l'errore che ho corretto poco fa in questo stesso file).

Il controllo `is_int($rawMediaKey) || is_string($rawMediaKey)` è un **type-narrowing guard**: PHPStan capisce che dentro quel ramo `$rawMediaKey` è per forza `int|string`, quindi `$mediaKey` diventa `int|string|null` — tipo compatibile con tutto ciò che segue. A runtime è sostanzialmente un no-op (una PK è sempre int o string), ma serve a soddisfare lo static analyzer senza ricorrere a un cast forzato (`(int) $rawMediaKey`, che silenzierebbe l'errore ma nasconderebbe un eventuale `null` reale).
